Configure Tesseract OCR for an English PNG image

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "xberg"
result = Xberg.extract(Xberg::ExtractInput.new(kind: 'uri', mime_type: 'image/png', uri: 'https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png'), { 'ocr' => { 'backend' => 'tesseract', 'enabled' => true, 'language' => ['eng'], 'tesseract_config' => { 'psm' => 6 } } })
puts result.results[0].content.inspect
```
